violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: Management presented an expired Certified Food Manager certificate
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION AND PROVIDED A VALID CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink next to the 3-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. STAFF REFILLED THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER WITH PAPER TOWELS. MOBY DICK GREAT FALLS (Inspection Date: 09/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed black slime on the underside of the drink dispensers at the self-service area.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC DRAINED THE DRINKS DISPENSERS AND BEGAN CLEANING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) in the open air Pepsi cooler, yogurt drink did not bare a date marking of when it was made
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DATE MAKE THE YOGURT DRINKS. SEE DATE MARKING HAND OUT.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths were being store in water.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC PUT SANITIZER SOLUTION IN THE SANITIZER BUCKET.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean KABOB SKEWERS were stored UNDER THE DRAIN BOARD OF THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK in a manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO MOVE THE CLEAN SKEWER TO A DIFFERENT LOCATION. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter attached to the faucet of the mop sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL BY THE NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw salmon kabobs were observed being stored over Ready-to-eat sauces
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED RAW SALMON TO THE RAW ANIMAL PROTEIN SHELF AND NEXT TO RAW BEEF KABOBS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DR stacked Hot Box, roasted tomatoes were observed at 125f; 2) on top of the steam well, cooked raisin and carrot mixture was observed at 104f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REHEAT THE FOOD TO 165f. AFTER PROPER REHEATING, FOOD CAN BE HOT HELD AT 135f OR HOTTER.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) saffron juice
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC LABELED THE JUG OF SAFFRON JUICE. MOBY DICK GREAT FALLS (Inspection Date: 03/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives for consumer self-service were observed being stored horizontally where the blade and the handles were not uniformly arranged. Blades and handles were facing both directions.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ORIENT ALL SINGLE SERVICE UTENSILS IN A MANNER THAT ONLY ALLOWS FOR THE HANDLES TO BE TOUCHED BY CUSTOMER.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff member wash gloved hands in the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. MANAGEMENT INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBERS TO REMOVE SOILED GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE PUTTING ON NEW GLOVES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The hand sink next to the 3-compartment sink was observed blocked with a storage rack. A bucket was observed sitting in the basin of the same hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. MANAGEMENT REMOVED THE BUCKET OUT OF THE HAND SINK AND MOVED THE STORAGE RACK TO UNBLOCK THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS MUST BE FULLY ACCESSIBLE TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: staff member washed gloved hands then resumed in food preparation
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT ABOUT PROPER GLOVE USEAGE. MANAGEMENT INSTRUCTED STAFF MEMBERS TO WASH HANDS BEFORE CHANGING GLOVES. DO NOT WASH GLOVES; DISPOSE OF SINGLE USE GLOVES AFTER CHANGING TASKS (IE: HANDLING RAW MEAT, COOKING, TAKING OUT GARBAGE, ETC.)

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw salmon kabobs were observed being stored over Ready-to-eat food in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) melted saffron butter.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. MANAGEMENT POSTED A PAPER THAT HAS THE TIME IN WHICH THE BUTTER WAS SET OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Observed no written or signed Employee Illness Reporting Agreements on site.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS GAVE A SPANISH AND ENGLISH HARDCOPY OF THE FAIRFAX COUNTY “EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT” TO PIC. PIC HAD ALL EMPLOYEES READ AND SIGN A COPY OF THE DOCUMENT. PLEASE RETAIN THESE DOCUMENTS FOR FUTURE INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed no written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS GAVE PIC A COPY OF FAIRFAX COUNTY VOMIT AND DIARRHEA POLICY. PLEASE RETAIN THIS DOCUMENT.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff not wash their hands before putting on gloves. Observed staff not wash their hands when entering the kitchen and beginning work.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRAIN THEIR EMPLOYEES ON PROPER HANDWASHING. WASH HANDS WHEN BEGINNING WORK, BEFORE PUTTING ON GLOVES, AFTER HANDLING RAW MEAT, AFTER GOING TO THE BATHROOM, AFTER CHANGING TASKS, ETC. SEE WHEN TO WASH HANDOUT. MOBY DICK GREAT FALLS (Inspection Date: 04/01/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff wash their hands in the food prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL SINKS HAVE A PURPOSE. HAND SINKS ARE FOR HAND WASHING. FOOD PREP SINK IS FOR FOOD PREPARATION. THREE COMPARTMENT SINK IS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE TRAIN STAFF ON DESIGNATED SINK USAGE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed large plastic lids and a sanitizer bucket in the hand sink next to the three compartment sink. Observed a large pot lid and a sanitizer bucket in the hand sink next to the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE ALL OF THE OBJECTS OUT AND AWAY FROM THE HAND SINKS. HAND SINKS NEED TO BE FREE OF CLUTTER TO BE ENSURE PROPER HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: 1) Observed kitchen staff use the same pair of gloves while changing tasks. 2) Observed kitchen staff wash gloved hands.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT GLOVE ARE USED FOR ONE TASK. WASH HANDS AND CHANGE GLOVES WHEN CHANGING TASKS. DO NOT WASH GLOVED HANDS. SEE GLOVES USE HAND OUT.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: Observed the quaternary ammonia machine disconnected from the three compartment sink and not functioning. Staff could not get any quaternary ammonia sanitizer out of the machine. No sanitization was occurring.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO BUY BLEACH FOR CHLORINE SANITIZATION. STAFF ARRIVED WITH BLEACH DURING INSPECTION. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF HOW TO PREPARE IT.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Observed counter staff member not wearing any type of hair restraints while preparing pita. Observed kitchen staff member not wearing any type of hair restraints while cooking and preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO TIE THEIR HAIR OR WEAR A HAT OR HAIRNET WHEN PREPARING EXPOSED, UNPACKAGED FOOD.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: Observed the quaternary ammonia machine disconnected from the three compartment sink and not functioning. Staff could not get any quaternary ammonia sanitizer out of the machine. No sanitization was occurring. Observed no alternative methods (ie: dish machine, bleach) to sanitize on site.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO BUY BLEACH FROM A NEARBY STORE FOR CHLORINE SANITIZATION. STAFF ARRIVED WITH BLEACH DURING INSPECTION. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF HOW TO PREPARE IT.
